release.content: pubactions 0.1.0 was released on 2026-11-25 from commit bdda39aa1dbb4326fffb2fde561ea5a6663d4524 with these changes.

rows: pubactions: the composite actions retry, apt-install, terraform-init and pr-label, moved from pubrules 0.49.0 with their scenarios. terraform-init takes its provider mirror from a new optional input, mirror (empty by default: no mirror try), instead of reading mirror.terraform from pubrules.json

release.scope: the published release v0.1.0 of pubactions

summary.content: pubactions 0.1.0 in brief: pubactions' first release: four of pubrules' composite actions, moved out so a workflow can pin them apart from pubrules' releases. pubrules' cache action stays in pubrules.
summary.scope: the published release v0.1.0 of pubactions
